case_name: SaaS site missing meta + social tags

fixes.fix_code: <meta name="description" content="Acme SaaS helps growing teams manage projects, track tasks, and collaborate in real-time. Boost productivity with intuitive project management tools.">
fixes.fix_explanation: The meta description tag tells search engines what the page is about and appears in search results, directly impacting click-through rates.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> element, after the viewport meta tag and before the title tag or stylesheet links.

fixes.fix_code: <meta property="og:title" content="Acme SaaS — Project Management for Growing Teams">
fixes.fix_explanation: The og:title tag controls how your page title appears when shared on Facebook, LinkedIn, and other social platforms that use Open Graph.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> element, after the standard <title> tag.

fixes.fix_code: <meta property="og:description" content="Acme SaaS helps growing teams manage projects, track tasks, and collaborate in real-time. Boost productivity with intuitive project management tools.">
fixes.fix_explanation: The og:description provides a rich preview summary when your page is shared on social media, encouraging more engagement and clicks.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> element, immediately after the og:title meta tag.

fixes.fix_explanation: The og:image specifies the preview image displayed when your page is shared on social media, significantly increasing engagement rates.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> element, after the og:description meta tag. You must create and upload a 1200×630px image to /images/og-image.jpg.

fixes.fix_explanation: The twitter:card meta tag enables Twitter to display rich media previews with large images instead of plain text-only links.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> element, after the Open Graph tags. Also add <meta name="twitter:site" content="@acmesaas"> if you have a Twitter handle.
